text:
mike: FYI starting a short preflight for the driver+firmware+kernel bundle we want to roll this week. goal: cut XID frequency by >= 50% in staging without >5% capacity loss in eu-west :thinking_face:

julia: timeline? do we have the exact driver/firmware/kernel triad pinned? wondering about the hotpatch vs reboot decision for dedicated nodes

mike: triad pinned: driver 535.101, fw 2.4.1, kernel 6.1. we tested hotpatch in dev but need to smoke in staging. plan below.

anika: share the checklist pls, will run burnin on the suspect rack tomorrow afternoon (low usage window)

mike: checklist:
```
- snapshot current XID/ECC baseline (last 30d) per-region
- rollout to 10% of staging GPUs (evenly across regions) behind canary drain policy
- run continuous synthetic workload (long seq gen, 4 concurrent per card) for 6h
- collect dmesg + nvml logs, pci errors, kernel tracepoints
- if XID rate > baseline*0.6 then rollback
- if card eviction > 1% then abort and escalate
- post-check: run 48h heatmap to watch delayed spikes
```

ross: can we add KV cache warmup in the synthetic workload? some of the previous spikes correlated with cold cache churn

mike: good call — adding prefix/KV warmup and a couple short prompts that mimic real latency tails

julia: capacity questions: 10% of staging equals ~40 GPUs. if rollback triggers we need to drain+reimage 40 cards quickly. what's our replace budget?

anika: replace budget for staging is 12 GPUs per region. we should ensure the canary is spread so no single region loses >5% available capacity.

mike: will distribute 10% evenly across regions eu-west/us-west/apac. drain policy set to: graceful-drain with 5minGrace, immediate-evict threshold 10ms over SLO for 2 consecutive samples. config snippet: 
```
apiVersion: v1
kind: DrainPolicy
spec:
  mode: graceful
  graceSeconds: 300
  evictionLatencyThresholdMs: 10
  consecutiveSamples: 2
```

sre-bot: [automated] scheduled: staging-canary-1767801111 at 2024-11-14T20:00:00Z. smoke harness will run for 6h. alerts: paged if XID spike > baseline*0.6

julia: rollback plan? do we prefer hotpatch revert first or full node reboot? hotpatch revert is lower impact but we've had partial-state bugs before.

mike: revert hotpatch first. if revert doesn't restore baseline within 10 minutes, escalate to reboot. reboot path documented in ops-runbooks/upgrade-revert.md (internal).

anika: what about telemetry sampling? last time we missed tails because sample rate was 1/100. bump to 1/10 for canary window?

ross: +1 to 1/10. also enable extended nvlink/pci error counters in the agent for the window.

mike: updated telemetry: sampling=0.1, nvme+nvlink counters enabled. note cost: extra 3% egress and storage for 6h. approved? :money_with_wings:

julia: approved for staging. not for production yet.

sre-bot: [checklist] preflight items remaining: telemetry bump pending (mike), canary distribution pending (mike), canary runbook posted (anika).

anika: I posted the runbook in /docs/staging-canary-runbooks and added quick commands for triage: 
```
# tail dmesg on suspected node
ssh node-123 "sudo journalctl -k -f | grep -i xid"
# nv-smi health snapshot
ssh node-123 "nvidia-smi --query-gpu=memory.used,utilization.gpu --format=csv"
```

mike: starting the canary now, will post logs and short summary at the end. ping me if alerts fire.

julia: thanks — please tag me on any eviction or XID > baseline*0.6.

mike: deploy-bot: canary-start 1767801111

deploy-bot: acknowledged. canary run id=canary-1767801111, targets=40gpus across eu-west/us-west/apac. monitoring hooks enabled.

sre-bot: [automated] first 30m snapshot: XID rate = baseline*0.48, pci errors unchanged, no evictions. continuing run.

mike: initial smoke looks promising. will let it run the full 6h then share full traces. thanks for quick reviews. :thumbsup:
